standard_prerequisites.name: The characterization of the closed points of a quasi-compact space through the closed subsets
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 1996-2004)
standard_prerequisites.use: Produces a minimal closed subset and hence a closed point.

core_obligations: Produce a closed point: among the nonempty closed subsets of the quasi-compact space choose a minimal one, which consists of a single closed point (proof lines 1995-2004)

Complement: the complement of that point need not be quasi-compact in general, and the proof records the counterexample showing that the additional hypothesis of the statement is exactly what is needed (proof lines 2005-2011)
